script: Welcome to lecture four on optimization. In 1986, Geoffrey Hinton popularized backpropagation for multi-layer perceptrons. The learning rate was set to 0.05 across 128 batch iterations.

independent_review.notes: Audio synthesized via Microsoft Zira Desktop (SAPI5). Utterance 1 clear. Utterance 2: 'Geoffrey Hinton' vocalized accurately as /ˈdʒɛfri ˈhɪntən/; '1986' pronounced 'nineteen eighty-six'; 'backpropagation' articulated clearly. Utterance 3: '0.05' pronounced 'zero point zero five'; '128' as 'one hundred twenty-eight'. Slides: Slide 2 near-duplicate has hamming distance 0 to Slide 1; Slide 4 strictly extends Slide 3.
